title: Mine Didn't Have the Screen Print Image
text: Mine Didn't Have the Screen Print Image. When these first arrived, I thought that I had received buffalo plaid napkins instead of placemats. After reading the product description again, I decided that these were placemats, mine just didn't have the screen print image on them. Mine are just plain red & black buffalo plaid. They're a bit thin and fold really easily which is why I thought they were napkins. My husband didn't think they were napkins because the plaid was only on one side. They're pretty basic for a placemat, but they do look good on the table. And they do protect the table from food spills.
